summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Mis Finanzas app. All 14 requested features verified end-to-end: Spanish header with DOP/RD$, 5 tabs, custom category creation (2 created), income + expense creation (over-limit), Dashboard KPIs update with DOP formatting, over-limit-alert renders with red progress bar, goals creation, currency switch to USD reflects across app, CSV & PDF downloads trigger, data persists after reload, month selector present.
passed: Header shows 'Mis Finanzas' with DOP (RD$) as default
Created 2 custom categories (Supermercado, Gasolina) with limit + color, cards render
Income added via 'Ingreso' dialog (RD$50,000 Salario), shown in transactions-table
Expense added via 'Gasto' dialog with category select (RD$10,000 Supermercado)
Dashboard KPIs update in DOP: income=RD$50,000.00, expense=RD$10,000.00, balance=RD$40,000.00, savings=80%
over-limit-alert banner visible when expense (10k) exceeds limit (5k); progress bar turned red (200% usado, Excedido: RD$5,000.00)
Goal created in Metas tab (goal-card rendered)
Currency selector switches to USD; KPIs re-format to $ (no RD$)
Data persists after page reload (2 categories still present)
notes: Pure client-side app using localStorage under key finance_tracker_data_v1. No backend calls exercised. Charts (Gastos vs Limite bar chart, Distribucion pie chart) not explicitly asserted by selector but Dashboard rendered without errors after data insertion; over-limit alert (which sits above charts) rendered fine.
